Xi'an Jiaotong University's Graduate School academic conduct regulation states that registered graduate students should observe academic ethics and norms, independently complete degree theses under supervisor guidance, and must avoid academic falsification including fabrication, plagiarism, buying or selling theses, and ghostwriting.

Xi'an Jiaotong University's Teacher Teaching Development Center listed an October 2024 workshop on large language models and intelligent learning, with content points including ChatGPT use in research, office work, and teaching, domestic AI models, vertical-domain AI, GPT risk warnings, and strategies for responding to student assignments.

Xi'an Jiaotong University's Teacher Teaching Development Center listed a December 2023 teaching seminar on generative AI and ChatGPT effects on university educational testing and assessment; the notice framed the content as discussion of learning, innovation, global generative AI policies, education quality, academic integrity, current assessment practices, and future trends.
